item.title: Xavier Arts fest opens with Cebuano “Frankenstein”
item.description: The Xavier Arts Festival, Panaghupong 18, opened on February 4—just a day before Tropical Storm Basyang made landfall in Mindanao—underscoring how cultural work continues even as communities brace for disruption.
